description: Read and collect product reviews and questions, and sync orders, products and customers with Yotpo.

yotpo_customer_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is added to Yotpo or their details change.

output.customer: The record returned by the service

yotpo_new_low_rating_review_trigger.description: Runs when a customer writes a review with the number of stars you choose or fewer.

output.review: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Run for reviews with this many stars or fewer.
parameters.name: max_rating

yotpo_new_order_trigger.description: Runs when an order placed in the last three days reaches Yotpo.

output.order: The record returned by the service

yotpo_new_question_trigger.description: Runs when a shopper's question about a product is published.

output.question: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: The product whose questions to watch, by the ID your store gave it.
parameters.name: product

yotpo_new_review_trigger.description: Runs when a customer writes a review, published or awaiting moderation.

output.review: The record returned by the service

yotpo_order_cancelled_trigger.description: Runs when an order placed in the last three days is marked canceled in Yotpo.

output.order: The record returned by the service

yotpo_review_escalated_trigger.description: Runs when Yotpo escalates a review for moderation, such as for a low rating or bad language.

output.review: The record returned by the service

yotpo_review_published_trigger.description: Runs when a review appears on your storefront, whether published automatically or by moderation.

output.review: The record returned by the service
